findings.message: proposed (not approved) glossary row iustitia (FIX) matched: iustitia → righteousness (the default in works on grace and the law) or justice (the distributive or forensic sense). Context decides; keep one choice per passage and flag the doubtful ones AMBIGUITATE.

proposed (not approved) glossary row peccatum (FIX) matched: peccatum → sin; peccator → sinner; peccare → to sin. The rendering is the word itself and its family (sins, sinful, sinless, sinner, sinned, sinning), not any word that starts with the letters: since, single and sincere are not sin.
proposed (not approved) glossary row voluntas (PREFER) matched: voluntas → will (the faculty); voluntas Dei → the will of God. Not "wish" unless the context is a wish.
proposed (not approved) glossary row iustificare (FIX) matched: iustificare → to justify; iustificatio → justification.
